name: branding-cat-h-monogram-on-tee-label-and-embroidered-cap
title: Rounded h letter with a cat head peeking from its arch, on a woven tee label and a periwinkle cap
whatItIs: A white slide with a fat black lowercase h whose shoulder becomes a cat with pointed ears and a white eye, captioned 'hisshatch apparel', and two photos: the mark on a woven neck label in a periwinkle tee and embroidered in white on a matching cap.
whatItMeans: Cute and witty; the cat hides in the letter, and periwinkle merch feels fresh.
techniques: Hide an animal inside a letter's counter shape.
Use one white eye dot as the only detail.
Apply as woven label and embroidery.
Match all merch to one periwinkle.

vocabulary.definition: An animal concealed in a letterform.
A logo stitched onto a garment.
A single dot creating a face.
